tools.file-transfer.faqs.0.question: Are my files uploaded to a server?
tools.file-transfer.faqs.0.answer: No. Files are transferred directly from one device to the other over an encrypted WebRTC connection. Only tiny connection-setup messages pass through public relays — your file data never touches any server.
tools.file-transfer.faqs.1.question: Do both devices need to be on the same network?
tools.file-transfer.faqs.1.answer: No. The transfer works anywhere both devices are online, even on different networks. When both are on the same Wi-Fi, transfers are usually faster because the data stays on your local network.
tools.file-transfer.faqs.2.question: What is the maximum file size?
tools.file-transfer.faqs.2.answer: There is no built-in limit. Files are held in the browser's memory during transfer, so very large files (several GB) depend on the receiving device's available memory. For best results, keep single transfers under 2 GB.
tools.file-transfer.faqs.3.question: Is the transfer secure?
tools.file-transfer.faqs.3.answer: Yes. The connection is end-to-end encrypted (DTLS), and only someone who knows your 6-character room code can join. The code is generated randomly on your device.
tools.file-transfer.faqs.4.question: Which devices are supported?
tools.file-transfer.faqs.4.answer: Any modern browser works — Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari on desktop, Android and iOS. No app installation needed; the other device just scans the QR code or opens the link.

tools.file-transfer.guide.whatIs.title: What is this tool?
tools.file-transfer.guide.whatIs.body.0: File Transfer lets you move files between your own devices — for example from your phone to your laptop — without cables, cloud storage or instant messengers. Both devices open this page, connect with a short room code, and files travel directly between them.
tools.file-transfer.guide.whatIs.body.1: The transfer uses WebRTC, the same technology behind video calls, so data is end-to-end encrypted and goes straight from device to device. Nothing is stored, and there are no accounts or size limits.
tools.file-transfer.guide.howTo.title: How to transfer files
tools.file-transfer.guide.howTo.intro: You need both devices online at the same time, each with this page open.
tools.file-transfer.guide.howTo.items.0: On the sending device, click Create a room — you get a 6-character code and a QR code.
tools.file-transfer.guide.howTo.items.1: On the receiving device, scan the QR code with the camera, open the shared link, or type the code into Join a room.
tools.file-transfer.guide.howTo.items.2: Wait until the page shows that a device is connected.
tools.file-transfer.guide.howTo.items.3: Drag files into the drop area or click to choose them — the transfer starts automatically and the file downloads on the other device.
tools.file-transfer.guide.tips.title: Tips
tools.file-transfer.guide.tips.items.0: Keep both tabs open until every transfer shows as complete.
tools.file-transfer.guide.tips.items.1: On the same Wi-Fi network, transfers are fastest and never use mobile data.
tools.file-transfer.guide.tips.items.2: If the connection drops, create a new room and continue with the remaining files.

tools.answer-book.faqs.0.question: Is this a real fortune teller?
tools.answer-book.faqs.0.answer: No — answers are picked at random. Treat it as a fun decision helper, not a prediction.

tools.bank-card-validate.metadata.title: Card Number Check - Validate with Luhn Online
tools.bank-card-validate.metadata.descri: Free online bank card number validator using the Luhn algorithm. Check whether a card number passes the checksum. Runs in your browser.
tools.bank-card-validate.title: Card Number Check
tools.bank-card-validate.description: Enter a card number to check whether it passes the Luhn checksum — the same check used by payment networks to catch typos.
tools.bank-card-validate.faqs.0.question: What is the Luhn algorithm?
tools.bank-card-validate.faqs.0.answer: A simple checksum formula used by payment cards to catch mistyped digits. It validates the number's structure, not whether the card exists.
tools.bank-card-validate.faqs.1.question: Is my card number stored?
tools.bank-card-validate.faqs.1.answer: No. Everything is processed locally in your browser; nothing is sent or saved.
tools.bank-card-validate.labels.valid: This number passes the Luhn check
tools.bank-card-validate.labels.invalid: This number fails the Luhn check
tools.bank-card-validate.labels.luhnNote: Luhn only verifies the checksum — it does not confirm the card exists.
tools.blood-type.metadata.title: Blood Type Inheritance - Possible Child Blood Types
tools.blood-type.metadata.description: Free online blood type inheritance calculator. Select the parents' ABO blood types to see which blood types their child can or cannot have. Runs in your browser.
tools.blood-type.title: Blood Type Inheritance
tools.blood-type.description: Select the father's and mother's ABO blood types to instantly see which blood types their child can have — and which are impossible.
tools.blood-type.faqs.0.question: Why are some blood types impossible?
tools.blood-type.faqs.0.answer: Blood type follows Mendelian inheritance of the A, B and O alleles. Combining the parents' possible genotypes rules out some types.
tools.blood-type.faqs.1.question: Is this medical advice?
tools.blood-type.faqs.1.answer: No. It is a general genetics table. For anything important, consult a doctor or geneticist.

tools.calendar.faqs.0.question: Can I choose any year?
tools.calendar.faqs.0.answer: Yes — enter any year and the tool builds the correct month layouts, including leap years.
tools.calendar.faqs.1.question: Can I print it?
tools.calendar.faqs.1.answer: Yes. Download the PNG and print it, or use it as a wallpaper or planner insert.
